title: o-mcp/readings version 1
description: What one node's meters read over a window, one series per device and quantity, one point per interval. Returned by meter_readings. Times are site time with their offset; the window is half-open (end excluded). A COUNTER point is consumption over the interval; a SAMPLE point the mean, min, max and 95th percentile of its 15-minute values (each the last reading in its 15 minutes) or minute values; power factor is decoded to 0..1 first. Unknown fields may appear in later version-1 documents; ignore them.

schema.description: Names the format. Check it, and version, before reading anything else.

version.description: Format version. Adding fields keeps it at 1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field makes 2.

node.description: Code of the node the server resolved the request to.

as_of.description: Which devices were on the node: as on this day.

interval.description: Point size; window is one point for the whole window. hour and day follow site time. minute reads minute telemetry; only the frontend's API gives it, for windows of 6 hours or less.

window.description: The window, start included, end excluded.

device.description: The one device asked for, or null for all on the node.

series.description: One per device and quantity, by device code.

unit.description: Unit of consumption, or of mean, min and max.

reading.description: COUNTER: points carry consumption. SAMPLE: points carry mean, min and max.

decoded.description: True for power factor: the meter's quadrant encoding (-2..2) was decoded to 0..1 before any statistic, so leading and lagging are no longer told apart.

points.description: One per interval that has data, in time order. A missing interval had no readings.

start.description: Start of the interval, site time with offset.

consumption.description: COUNTER only: the register's increase over the interval. Consumption across a gap in readings lands in the first interval after it.

mean.description: SAMPLE only: mean of the interval's values (15-minute values, or minute values at interval minute).

min.description: SAMPLE only: smallest value in the interval. A 15-minute value is the last reading in its 15 minutes, so a shorter dip between two of them doesn't show.

max.description: SAMPLE only: largest value in the interval, of the same values as min.

p95.description: SAMPLE only: the 95th percentile (continuous) of the same values as min. Added within version 1: an older document has none.

samples.description: Values in the interval: 15-minute values (4 per full hour), or minute values at interval minute.

rejected.description: COUNTER only: steps where the register went backwards or jumped implausibly, counted as zero.

findings.description: What the server noticed. Show message as is.

code.description: NO_READINGS: a device has no values of a quantity in the window. COUNTER_RESET: some steps were rejected, so consumption is a lower bound.
